headline: Flood pump station upgrades and enforcement orders at 5 Appleton Street, 461 Northampton Street, and 98 Lower Westfield Road.
summary: A notice of intent from the city's Engineering Department covers electrical upgrades and building repairs at flood pump stations. Three enforcement orders involve cutting trees near a resource area, grading along the Connecticut River, and dumping near Tannery Brook.
items: Request for Determination of Applicability from Berkshire and Eastern Railroad: confirm wetland boundaries along the BERX Connecticut River Line right-of-way in Holyoke, part of a five-year vegetation management plan

Notice of Intent (continued from 10/22/26) from City of Holyoke Engineering Department: electrical upgrades at Flood Pump Stations #1 through #7, sluice gate actuator replacements at Tailrace Structure #6 and Tailrace Intake and Gatehouse Structures #24, and limited building envelope repairs at Flood Pump Stations #5 through #7
Enforcement Order (continued from 10/22/26) at 5 Appleton Street (MBP: 049-01-006): grading and fill along about 470 lineal feet of banks near the Connecticut River
Enforcement Order (continued from 10/08/26) at 461 Northampton Street (MBP: 223-00-011): tree and shrub removal and a wood chip pile in the 100' buffer zone
Enforcement Order at 98 Lower Westfield Road (MBP: 174-00-021): illegal dumping and altering of a bordering vegetated wetland within the 200' buffer of Tannery Brook
Formal vote on minutes from 10/22/26 meeting
Discussion of department goal: education for property owners in buffer zones of resource areas
Discussion of a coffee hour hosted by the Conservation Department
Discussion of upcoming items for the 12/10/26 meeting
Mail and other items not reasonably anticipated by the Chair
